items.distractor_fact: Das Thermometer im Nachbarort zeigte am selben Nachmittag {D} Grad Celsius an.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring village showed {D} degrees Celsius that same afternoon.
items.entity_note: A thermometer in a different village, not the one whose noon/morning readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Die Aktie eines anderen Unternehmens schloss am selben Tag bei {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: The stock of a different company closed that same day at {D} euros.
items.entity_note: A different company's stock price, not the one whose opening/closing prices the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Der Pegel eines anderen Flusses stand am selben Abend bei {D} Zentimetern.
items.gloss_en: The level of a different river stood that same evening at {D} centimeters.
items.entity_note: A different river's water level, not the one whose evening/morning readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Auf einem anderen Konto wurden {D} Euro eingezahlt.
items.gloss_en: Into a different account, {D} euros were deposited.
items.entity_note: A deposit into a different account, not the one whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Haushalt hatte im selben Monat Ausgaben von {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: A different household had expenses of {D} euros that same month.
items.entity_note: A different household's expenses, not the one whose income/expenses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine andere Mannschaft erzielte in der Saison {D} Tore.
items.gloss_en: A different team scored {D} goals in the season.
items.entity_note: A different team's goals scored, not the one whose scored/conceded goals the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Anleger verzeichnete im selben Jahr Gewinne von {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: A different investor recorded gains of {D} euros that same year.
items.entity_note: A different investor's gains, not the one whose gains/losses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine andere Fabrik produzierte im selben Monat {D} Stück.
items.gloss_en: A different factory produced {D} units that same month.
items.entity_note: A different factory's actual output, with its own unstated plan, not the factory whose actual/planned output the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: In einer anderen Region fielen im selben Monat {D} Millimeter Niederschlag.
items.gloss_en: In a different region, {D} millimeters of rain fell that same month.
items.entity_note: A different region's actual rainfall, with its own unstated forecast, not the region whose actual/forecast rainfall the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Golfer benötigte an einem anderen Loch {D} Schläge.
items.gloss_en: A different golfer needed {D} strokes on a different hole.
items.entity_note: A different golfer on a different hole, whose par is not stated, not the golfer/hole the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Golfer beendete eine andere Runde mit {D} Schlägen.
items.gloss_en: A different golfer finished a different round with {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: A different golfer's different round, whose par is not stated, not the golfer/round the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Zug erreichte auf einer anderen Strecke den Bahnhof {D} Minuten nach Mitternacht.
items.gloss_en: A different train, on a different line, reached the station {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line, whose schedule is not stated, not the train whose actual/scheduled arrival the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Flug landete auf einer anderen Strecke {D} Minuten nach Mitternacht.
items.gloss_en: A different flight, on a different route, landed {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different flight on a different route, whose schedule is not stated, not the flight whose actual/scheduled landing the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein anderer Pegelsensor an einer anderen Messstelle zeigte einen Wasserstand von {D} Zentimetern an.
items.gloss_en: A different water-level sensor, at a different measuring site, showed a water level of {D} centimeters.
items.entity_note: A different sensor at a different site, whose own reference line is not stated, not the sensor whose level/reference the question compares.
